x: Drew made good use of his mark of 11 yards to win the final, with Syd Jarlett second and Charlie Jones third. V.
Morris, the Police champion, won the 880 Yards and Alf Orton ran well to credit us with third place. Rene Howell gained us first place in the 1 Mile and V.
Hartley of L.A.C. in the 440 Yards race, and Alf Orton did well to gain third place in the 880 event. Rene Howell won the 1 Mile for the Poly but only after a great race with V.
Jack Wigley won the 100 Yards for the home club, with Dicky Dumbrill in second place, a position he also occupied in the 220. Morris won the 880 for the Police and V.
Herbert, however, ran a splendid race to win in 4 mins. 25.6 secs., which just beat his previous Club record for this race. V.
Higgins, the Public Schools' quarter champion, beat Ted Read in the 220, and scored a double by also winning the 440, in which Jack Frost finished third. V.
Les Stokell was once again a good 7th man and Albert Frost and Dick Tobin completed our team. Positions were: 2 V.
